notes: WARDOGS weight-class shape from public gear guides (September 2026), not a studio export and not a ban table. Move penalties are community measurements: lightest 0-10 kg no move penalty, light 10-17 kg about -5%, medium 17-27 kg about -13%, heavy and super-heavy about -20%. Absolute sprint speed is intentionally unset. Speed scoring stays off until the dedicated server sends expected_max_ground_speed_mps per sample (preferred; this also covers the adrenaline pen, which reduces equipment weight class) or you set reference_lightest_speed_mps from your own server build. Do not copy another game's meters per second in here.
